# A Late Basket

*Brigid is late with Elspeth's herb basket. Clear 40 Wrack Boars from Strandwood Edge, and tell Elspeth the basket will be late.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Goa Harbour](../towns/goa_harbour_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Brigid](../npcs/brigid_herbs.md) |
| Level | 24 |

## Objectives

- Defeat 40 [Wrack Boar](../monsters/wrack_boar.md)
- Talk to [Elspeth](../npcs/elspeth_healer.md)

## Rewards

- 3,000 EXP
- 960 mesos
- [Sea-Herb Salve](../items/sea_herb_salve.md) x3
- +20 standing with Goa Harbour
- +150 standing with [Brigid](../npcs/brigid_herbs.md)
